ul.li: Implemented highlight of search terms using the accent color.
Increased clickable area of expanders in the network list and improved node alignment.
Enhanced screen reader announcements of messages and events.
Made sidebar rows focusable, enabling screen readers to read out the title.
Added accessible label to all network list rows, enabling screen readers to read out the name, type and status.
Added support for using Left, Right and Delete keypad shortcuts in the network list.
Added Ctrl+W keyboard shortcut to close the window.
Now using -- instead of -e option for Terminal commands.
When approving newly joined members using notification actions, the window is now presented and the member selected.
Notifications with actions are now automatically dismissed when no longer relevant.
Any remaining notifications are now automatically dismissed on quit.
Fixed automatic scrolling to newly added networks at the very end of the list.
Updated Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese and Lithuanian translations.
Added Menu and Shift+F10 keyboard shortcuts to open the menu of commands editor rows.
Dropped support for all Hamachi versions older than 2.1.0.203.
Improved memory safety for background threads that determine network ownership or retrieve long nicks.
Updated Hungarian, Japanese, Slovak and Turkish translations.

issues.issue: Critical log message is shown on startup

ul.li: Sidebar title is now shown in the headerbar when scrolled down.
Enabled automatic row selection in the network list when searching or after a row is collapsed or removed.
Return and Delete key presses are now passed on to the selected row when search entry is focused.
Search entry can now be refocused by pressing Ctrl+F while search mode is already active.
When using drag and drop to reorder a command the dragged row is now anchored to the point where the drag started.
Added option to duplicate existing commands.
Added toast with button to undo removal when removing a command.
Updated Swedish translation.
Within "Add Command" and "Edit Command" dialogs command variables can now be inserted directly from the popover into the command entries.
Added more network list update interval options to preferences dialog.
Added debug information to about dialog.
Added Hungarian translation (thanks to therealmate).
Updated Polish and Portuguese translations.
Redesigned user interface utilizing GTK4 and libadwaita.
Added preference for dark and light style or following the system mode.
Added support for multiple search terms when searching networks and members.
Changed online and total member count in sidebar to include the client itself.
Changed accelerator to open preferences to Control+,.
Changed default network list update interval to 30 seconds.
Implemented Xdp.Portal to request permission to run in the background and to set the status.
Added Finnish translation (thanks to Jiri Grönroos).
Updated Brazilian Portuguese, Dutch, Indonesian, Japanese, Lithuanian, Russian, Spanish and Ukrainian translations.
